# Intent Statement: Bakery Pre-order App

## Problem Statement

Customers of the bakery can't be sure the items they want will still be available when they arrive, so they want to reserve those items in advance. [Q1]

The proposed answer is a web app for pre-ordering from the bakery. [desc]

## Target Customer

Customers of one single bakery, who benefit by securing the items they want before they arrive. [Q1] [Q2]

## Success Metrics

The proof of concept succeeds when a customer can place a pre-order and see it confirmed as reserved, and bakery staff can see that order. [Q3]

## Initiative Trigger

This is a quick test of the idea; no reporting is needed beyond this workflow. [Q4]

## Initial Scope Signal

- Workflow-selected scope: `poc`. [scope]
- User-confirmed product boundary: a proof of concept to test the idea. [Q5]

## Assumptions & Open Questions

None.
